defs.d: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
defs.ex: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.

defs.d: The at sign (@).
In, near, or in the general vicinity of a particular place.
defs.ex: Caesar was at Rome;  at the corner of Fourth Street and Vine;  at Jim’s house

defs.d: (indicating time) Indicating occurrence in an instant of time or a period of time relatively short in context or from the speaker's perspective.
defs.ex: at six o’clock;  at closing time;  at night.

defs.d: The details of the food to be served at a banquet; a bill of fare.
A list of dishes offered in a restaurant.
A publication, usually published daily or weekly and usually printed on cheap, low-quality paper, containing news and other articles.
A quantity of or one of the types of paper on which newspapers are printed.
To cover with newspaper.
defs.ex: She newspapered one end of the room before painting the bookcase.

defs.d: To engage in the business of journalism (usually used only in the gerund, newspapering)
defs.ex: He newspapered his way through the South on the sports beat, avoiding dry towns.

defs.d: A cutting; a part cut out from the rest of something.
A part, piece, subdivision of anything.
To cut, divide or separate into pieces.
To reduce to the degree of thinness required for study with the microscope.
The decision or judgement of a jury or court; a verdict.
defs.ex: The court returned a sentence of guilt in the first charge, but innocence in the second.

defs.d: The judicial order for a punishment to be imposed on a person convicted of a crime.
defs.ex: The judge declared a sentence of death by hanging for the infamous cattle rustler.

defs.d: To declare a sentence on a convicted person; to doom; to condemn to punishment.
defs.ex: The judge sentenced the embezzler to ten years in prison, along with a hefty fine.

defs.d: To decree or announce as a sentence.
To run.
Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.
defs.ex: I just got back from my morning run.

defs.d: Act or instance of hurrying (to or from a place) (not necessarily by foot); dash or errand, trip.
defs.ex: I need to make a run to the store.

defs.d: To move swiftly.
(fluids) To flow.
To impart
To share

One of the eight players (comprising two props, one hooker, two locks, two flankers and one number eight, collectively known as the pack) whose primary task is to gain and maintain possession of the ball (compare back).
A player on a team in football (soccer) in the row nearest to the opposing team's goal, who are therefore principally responsible for scoring goals.
To advance, promote.
To send (a letter, email etc.) to a third party.
defs.ex: I'll be glad to forward your mail to you while you're gone.

defs.d: Toward the front or at the front.
defs.ex: The fire was confined to the forward portion of the store.

defs.d: Without customary restraint or modesty; bold, cheeky, pert, presumptuous or pushy.

A hand-held device consisting of concertinaed material, or slats of material, gathered together at one end, that may be opened out into the shape of a sector of a circle and waved back and forth in order to move air towards oneself and cool oneself.
An electrical or mechanical device for moving air, used for cooling people, machinery, etc.
To blow air on (something) by means of a fan (hand-held, mechanical or electrical) or otherwise.
defs.ex: We enjoyed standing at the edge of the cliff, being fanned by the wind.

defs.d: To slap (a behind, especially).
(usually in the plural) Anything that is sold by itself, especially an article of clothing.
To divide (a thing) into separate parts.
defs.ex: Separate the articles from the headings.

defs.d: To disunite from a group or mass; to disconnect.
Apart from (the rest); not connected to or attached to (anything else).
defs.ex: This chair can be disassembled into five separate pieces.

defs.d: (followed by “from”) Not together (with); not united (to).
defs.ex: I try to keep my personal life separate from work.

defs.d: A place or location.
A post of employment; a job.
To put into place.
A circular device capable of rotating on its axis, facilitating movement or transportation or performing labour in machines.
The breaking wheel, an old instrument of torture.
To roll along on wheels.
defs.ex: Wheel that trolley over here, would you?

defs.d: To transport something or someone using any wheeled mechanism, such as a wheelchair.
To make someone believe, or feel sure about something, especially by using logic, argument or evidence.
defs.ex: I wouldn't have or do something, unless I'm convinced that it's good.

defs.d: To persuade.
A plan, drawing, sketch or outline to show how something works, or show the relationships between the parts of a whole.
defs.ex: Electrical diagrams show device interconnections.

defs.d: A graph or chart.
To represent or indicate something using a diagram.
To schedule the operations of a locomotive or train according to a diagram.
Sensation; sensibility.
That which impresses itself on the senses; anything perceptible.
Perceptible by the senses.
Easily perceived; appreciable.
An act of recommending.
That which is recommended.
A painting or other picture of a person, especially the head and shoulders.
An accurate depiction of a person, a mood, etc.
defs.ex: The author painted a good portrait of urban life in New York in his latest book.

defs.d: To portray; to draw.
Representing the actual features of an individual; not ideal.
defs.ex: a portrait bust; a portrait statue

defs.d: Term of address.
Full of life; energetic.
Bright, glowing, vivid; strong, vigorous.
The process of exploring.
The process of penetrating, or ranging over for purposes of (especially geographical) discovery.
defs.ex: The exploration of unknown areas was often the precursor to colonization.

defs.d: A steady look, a gaze.
One's concern for another; esteem; relation, reference.
Extreme force.
defs.ex: The violence of the storm, fortunately, was more awesome than destructive.

defs.d: Action which causes destruction, pain, or suffering.
defs.ex: We try to avoid violence in resolving conflicts.

defs.d: To subject to violence.
